body:
Jet v6.3.3 has no interpreter cancellation/fuel budget and leaves recursive yielding and intermediate growth unbounded. This documentation-only proposal defines additive protection contracts and four prepared implementation assignments, based on upstream commit `202464510d5b57f0afa9c5563f75babc1616682c`.

Five RFCs cover execution ownership, value/output accounting, bounded compilation, restricted capabilities, and fork/upstream compatibility. The execution packet includes a source audit, dependency and file-ownership plan, bounded regression matrix, performance protocol, and small upstream-oriented PR sequence. Existing cyclic-dependency PR CloudyKit/jet#236 is explicitly reused rather than duplicated.

Start at [the RFC index](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/docs/execution-budget-rfcs/docs/rfcs/index.md) and [the execution plan](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/docs/execution-budget-rfcs/docs/plans/template-execution-budgets/plan.md). Downstream contract: https://github.com/ashtonian/karsto/issues/209.

Validation: local document links/fences and diff whitespace checked; all nine diagrams across the two planning repositories parsed with Mermaid 12.3.0. No runtime source, module identity or tests changed; no hostile probes or benchmarks executed. Implementation remains unstarted at the owner's direction. This PR makes no sandbox acceptance claim.
title: Plan context-aware template budgets and upstream contribution series

body:
Final-sink limits miss intermediate string/collection growth, rolled-back try buffers and discarded exec output. This change reserves logical construction before allocation and counts generated bytes after escaping across all those paths. Value/output exhaustion uses the shared sticky termination state and cannot become catch/isset success.

Head: `a81e7dbd5036bebe9b8bcb5de3676c2e87ccd3fe`. Production code is unchanged from `5583ec15361aea8f98c7a0d5a1fcbef25d407c0e`; the final commit adds public cost documentation, boundary/loop/isset coverage and portable validation evidence. Based on the explicit runtime foundation `32997fd20e6986220c8c0b60bfff9cedc49d46b7` in #3; this dependent PR targets `work/lane-1-runtime`.

Adds MaxValueBytes/MaxOutputBytes, inspectable value/output errors, bounded data-only formatting/JSON, immutable builtin descriptors and cooperative ConsumeSteps/ReserveValueBytes hooks for owned adapters. Nested commits avoid a second output charge while reserving new retained copies; rollback refunds neither budget. Invalid conversions return ordinary errors, map keys are evaluated once, and numeric-error copies are reserved before parsing. Metered diagnostics avoid expanding arbitrary values/scopes. Legacy Execute and the SafeWriter signature remain available; Go 1.16 and dependencies are preserved.

Validation:

- [Full Linux CI, final head](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42431027359): Go 1.16.15 normal, stable normal and stable race all pass. The earlier minimum-Go JSON bound failure is corrected and its evidence retained.
- Darwin Go 1.16.15 full suite passes; final loop/option/discard tests also pass on Go 1.16 and current Go. Focused compatibility/error checks, vet and the complete staged artifact/doc review pass. Original old-linker warnings remain in the log.
- Matching reservation-disabled/enabled controls use identical positive options and finite fixtures, differing by exactly one reservation line. The enabled value guard rejects 128 KiB growth before construction; enabled output rejects generation at 1 KiB, including exec discard. Flat/cumulative/source allocation views establish the affected allocation sites. Tests, manifests, commands, deadlines, cleanup, logs, RSS observations and expected failing controls are committed in [lane evidence](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/a81e7dbd5036bebe9b8bcb5de3676c2e87ccd3fe/docs/plans/template-execution-budgets/lane-2-evidence.md).
- All 11 lane commits are signed with the effective configured identity/key and verified locally and by GitHub. Working tree is clean. No fuzzing or OOM probes were run.

Logical construction accounting is not a heap/RSS cap. Arbitrary host callbacks, native formatting/marshaling, writers/loaders, unsupported reflection and diagnostic dump retain explicit capability boundaries. Descriptor identity and owned work/value implementations are ready for Lane 3; restricted denial/input/compilation acceptance remains its dependent gate. Karsto helper migration, actual webhook/chain/PDF workflows, fork packaging and the final performance program remain Lane 4. This draft does not establish tenant-safe execution or resolve #209.

This is the consolidated fork review/handoff PR and remains draft pending those dependencies. No upstream PR, issue or submission is authorized under the owner's hold. Internal assignment/RFC/evidence documents and fork CI are excluded from any future generic submission. A local filtered candidate patch against the foundation contains only Go source/tests and public execution docs; its reverse-application check passes (SHA-256 `8d604b14703eb6ca2037632a75291c01fc03196b751c2fe30cc7cae6dec8a53b`).
title: Account for value construction, generated output and builtin work

body:
Adds synchronous `Template.ExecuteContext` with one render-owned step/depth allowance across statements, empty loop bodies, expression/value traversal, block/content/yield/include/exec, inheritance traversal and callback return. Preserves `Execute` and Go 1.16 syntax. Sink errors and short writes survive escaping and try commits; runtime/ranger references are cleared on unwind.

Foundation for dependent work: **77025e5** (on `work/lane-1-runtime`; production **d2f089c**), following correctness **3863ed9** and YieldBlock repair **388f288**. Dependent branches should use this explicit SHA, not remote master.

- `Runtime.checkpoint(steps)`, `enter/leave`, `reserve(remaining, limit, requested, kind, cause)`: shared checked subtraction; failed reservations are terminal.
- `terminate(error)`, `rethrowTerminal/rethrowRecovered`: sticky error through try/isset and recovered callback panics. Actual runtime/non-error programming panics still escape the public entry as before.
- `beforeCall(value)`: real pre-invocation checkpoint used by Func/reflection, Renderer/printing, SafeWriter and ranger calls. Restricted capability admission remains dependent work; this is not an implemented policy.
- `executionContext()` and `loadTemplate(name,parent,sibling)`: actual runtime loading bridge for context-aware compilation; nested loads/exec use the same state. Compilation limits are not implemented here.
- `beginOutputTransaction/commitOutputTransaction`: actual try buffer/commit ownership; extend these for output/value charging. Discarded exec stays on the same runtime.

The request context is held only during synchronous execution as an adapter to existing Runtime/Arguments callbacks, and cleared before pooling. There is no worker/select timeout. Native callbacks, writers, loaders, channels and custom Rangers can block; execution waits for them.

Validation: upstream self-yield fatally overflows a 256 KiB Go stack in an externally supervised child; the same source returns depth termination under a finite allowance. Legacy silent computation ignores a cancelled caller; metered native-only work and pre-cancelled empty templates stop synchronously. Normal `go test -count=1 -p=1 -parallel=2 -timeout=120s ./...` and a separate `-race` run passed on Go 1.27.3/darwin/arm64. Go 1.16.15 full compatibility passes with external linking (the internal-link LC_UUID failure is retained separately). `go vet ./...` and exact terminal recovery/content-fuel regressions pass. CPU/allocation/heap/mutex/block profiles were inspected; adapter consolidation removes added allocation sites. The cached-dispatch diagnostic has matching upstream allocation counts, a roughly 1.08 median execution ratio across four fixtures and a disclosed 62%/47 ns header regression; application/p99/concurrency validation remains separate. Durable stage logs/receipts and exact commands are summarized in [runtime evidence](docs/plans/template-execution-budgets/lane-1-evidence.md).

Value/output and builtin accounting, parser/loading limits, capability/input admission, and downstream workflow validation are excluded. This foundation does not establish tenant-safe execution, and does not resolve Karsto #209. Upstream submission branches will exclude all internal assignment documents and fork packaging.


Upstream submissions: [correctness #237](https://github.com/CloudyKit/jet/pull/237), generic `822cf70`; [context/fuel/depth draft #238](https://github.com/CloudyKit/jet/pull/238), generic `1573061` stacked on #237. Submission Go/dependency/template blobs match validated canonical inputs, excluding all internal plans/RFCs and fork packaging. Commits are signed and verified locally and on GitHub. No tenant acceptance, merge or Karsto #209 closure is claimed.
title: Add synchronous execution ownership and interpreter budgets

body:
Adds a fixed corpus for headers, 8/64 KiB bodies, loops, escaping, strings and composition. Separate harnesses measure compile, cached Execute, parse+execute, sampled p50/p99 latency and fixed concurrency (1/2/8 workers, shared templates/separate Sets). Runtime remains the pinned upstream implementation; this does not enable tenant protection.

Per the owner's current direction, all work stays in this fork; no new CloudyKit PRs. Generic fixture commits are `f055df6` and `987e790`, separate from fork CI and internal evidence. Based on planning PR #1.

Validation: text/HTML corpus conformance passed; three normal benchmark/latency/concurrency samples collected; separate concurrent race exercise passed. CPU flat/cumulative, allocation/live-heap, mutex and block profiles were inspected. [Latest exact-SHA CI](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42426381271) passed full Go 1.16.15 normal, stable normal and stable race suites at `68bddd3fbd3fce1fce4f710400c6bd664db34d19`. All task commits are locally and GitHub verified. [Evidence, commands and remaining limits](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/68bddd3fbd3fce1fce4f710400c6bd664db34d19/docs/plans/template-execution-budgets/lane-4-evidence.md).

Lane 1's explicit foundation `77025e5` was fetched/reviewed. Packaging and Karsto adoption remain gated on accepted value/output and complete restricted invocation/builtin/namespace protection handoffs. No release, merge or sandbox claim.
title: Add representative execution fixtures and compatibility checks

body:
A parser syntax error currently drains the lexer producer through the remaining source before returning. Drive the existing scanner state functions synchronously from token requests instead. The parser can stop immediately, and no lexer goroutine owns the source after return. Token syntax and legacy entry points are unchanged.

The regression uses `{{ if }}` followed by trailing text: it fails with the producer/drain implementation and passes with the pull scanner. Existing lexer, parser, custom delimiter, cyclic dependency and concurrent diamond tests pass in normal and race builds. The integrated compatibility run also passes Go 1.16.15 normal, stable normal and stable race: https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42425163445.

The review base is CloudyKit/jet#236 at c9ec08935ddf15eaf9328128e008faf0bef5e079, preserved unchanged with its original author. This focused diff contains only scanner lifecycle code and tests; compilation limits are a separate dependent change. It provides no execution or callback isolation guarantee.
title: Drive template scanning synchronously from the parser

body:
Compilation can recurse or retain scanner/loader work before execution budgets apply. Add synchronous ParseContext/GetTemplateContext admission for per-source and total bytes, AST nodes, work, parser/expression/dependency depth and canonical template count. Cached graphs are revalidated against each request; cold and warm diamonds consume the same node allowance. Context/counters/active chains remain operation-local.

The pull scanner stops at parser failure. Owned loader reads and cleanup finish before return. Compilation cancellation/resource failure remains terminal through cleanup, while ordinary native loader panics retain legacy propagation. Existing Parse/GetTemplate signatures, useful partial syntax-error behavior, custom delimiters/comments, Unicode and development mode are preserved.

The cycle prerequisite remains the original third-party #236 commit c9ec08935ddf15eaf9328128e008faf0bef5e079, preserving its author. This PR is based on fork #5 at 6cf13002e0a9fcf0548b8a426c428802c7890553. Exact head 484d70de3c8bfb6f9da06483637e14e276eff439 passes compiler/lexer workflow tests using an exact-source overlay. The same compiler plus dependent runtime/profile changes passes full Go 1.16.15, stable normal and stable race CI at 2d95fa9e9f02a831febbd62c0fb10995a3496e7b: https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42431462657. Controlled baseline/fix cases cover cycles, scanner cleanup, cold/warm node admission, terminal Close errors and preserved native panics; deep finite probes run in bounded child processes.

The standalone API cannot preempt arbitrary blocking native loaders or supply execution-wide budgets by itself; #7 supplies the shared runtime bridge and explicit restricted profile. No heap/RSS or sandbox claim. Public API documentation is in docs/compilation.md. The diff excludes internal plans, restricted input/bundle code and fork packaging. Fork-only review; no upstream submission or merge is requested.
title: Add bounded context-aware template compilation

body:
Execution budgets alone still allow a Go function supplied in vars to run, and fresh compilation allowances on each include/exec let a render exceed graph limits. Add an explicitly selected immutable restricted profile and share compilation admission throughout nested execution.

NewRestrictedSet admits bounded source bundles and data-only globals. RenderRestrictedContext snapshots globals/vars/data, applies fixed positive execution/parse/input ceilings and returns an owned bounded string, empty on failure. External writers are denied on restricted templates to prevent callback reentry with a fresh allowance. Canonical namespace authorization precedes cache access; foreign Set cache entries are ignored. Optional missing templates require explicit namespace admission.

Builtin aliases use opaque private registry identities. Supported metered defaults preserve aliases through variables, containers and template returns; arbitrary functions, methods, native formatting/serialization hooks, channels and external Renderer/Ranger/SafeWriter are denied before invocation. Dump and unknown capabilities/AST kinds fail closed. Policy/resource failures remain terminal through evaluated try/isset paths. Depths must be 1–64. Trusted NewSet/Execute/ExecuteContext extension points remain available.

The controlled pre-profile workflow at bda0fa8 uses the same template, function input and positive execution/parse budgets: it returns "called", nil error, and invokes the callback. The restricted workflow returns ErrCapabilityDenied without invocation. Focused normal/race tests cover admission, capability aliases/returns/shadowing, immutable globals and snapshots, namespace/cache isolation, mixed concurrent trusted/restricted renders, output/value/compile ceilings and blocking native ownership. A 10-second external child with a 256 KiB stack validates the supported depth ceiling. Final vet passes.

Exact review head 2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15 passes Go 1.16.15 normal, stable normal and stable race: https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42431657520. The explicit base dd594d8cd6700395b96badc0b49bfc4b6b235e89 also passes: https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42431657452. It combines compiler #6 at 484d70de3c8bfb6f9da06483637e14e276eff439 and final value/builtin prerequisite a81e7dbd5036bebe9b8bcb5de3676c2e87ccd3fe from #2. Canonical integration 2d95fa9e9f02a831febbd62c0fb10995a3496e7b passes: https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/actions/runs/42431462657.

The public contract is in docs/restricted.md. Logical budgets are not heap/RSS or OS isolation; application-specific helpers absent from the audited registry require bounded implementations before consumer adoption. This review excludes internal assignment/RFC documents and fork packaging. Development and review remain in ashtonian/jet; no upstream submission or merge is requested.

Invocation self-review is complete for [dispatch/reflection/escaping](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15/eval.go), [ranges](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15/ranger.go), [formatting](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15/execution_print.go), [JSON](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15/builtin_json.go), loading and the owned result boundary. [Workflow regressions](https://github.com/ashtonian/jet/blob/2858cef45f7fdc9c100fe0294f367fea63c82a15/restricted_test.go) cover those dispositions; unsupported host hooks remain denied.
title: Enforce restricted rendering and shared compilation budgets

body:
Jet can report success after a writer failure. This patch makes `Execute` return the original error, detects short writes, and prevents try/catch from swallowing destination failures without changing `SafeWriter`'s signature.

It also clears caller references from pooled runtimes and rangers, restores try/catch state after errors, and fixes `Runtime.YieldBlock` rendering twice when given a context.

Remaining issues: some SafeWriter and callback paths still allow subsequent template work after a write failure. Returned writer errors also lose template filename/line diagnostics.

Validation on Go 1.27.3, darwin/arm64: the added writer, runtime cleanup, try-context, and YieldBlock regressions fail on the base revision and pass here. The submitted root-package suite passes:

```sh
go test -race -count=1 -p=1 -parallel=2 -timeout=120s .
```
title: Preserve sink errors and release execution state on unwind

body:
Jet has no interpreter-owned cancellation or work allowance. A silent loop can keep running after an application timeout, and a self-yielding block can overflow the Go stack. This adds synchronous ExecuteContext with a single render-owned step/depth budget across statements, silent loop advances, expression/value traversal, blocks/content/yield, includes, exec and inheritance traversal.

Depends on #237; its prerequisite correctness commits are included here, with the new API in the final commit. No fork packaging or internal assignment documents are included.

```go
err := tpl.ExecuteContext(ctx, writer, vars, data, jet.ExecutionOptions{
    MaxSteps: 100000,
    MaxDepth: 64,
})
```

These are example values, not safe defaults. Execute remains unlimited; zero low-level limits mean unlimited. Nil context and negative depth are invalid before runtime acquisition. ErrStepLimit/ErrDepthLimit and LimitError preserve errors.Is/As; context errors and Go 1.20+ cancellation causes remain inspectable without raising the Go 1.16 requirement.

Cancellation and budget failures are sticky through try/catch, isset and callbacks that recover interpreter panics. Ordinary template errors and rollback remain supported. Execution owns cleanup synchronously; no worker/select timeout is added. Native Func/reflection/Renderer/SafeWriter/Ranger calls have entry/return checkpoints, but arbitrary Go code, writers, loaders, channels and implicit formatting hooks cannot be preempted. Public reentry from native Go code starts a new top-level render.

This API does not enforce value/output allocation, builtin bounds, compilation/load/input admission or a restricted capability policy. It is not an untrusted-template sandbox or a hard CPU/memory boundary. A sufficiently large/unlimited depth can still exhaust the Go stack.

Validation:

- Controlled upstream self-yield child with a 256 KiB Go-stack cap fatally overflows; the same source/cap with finite depth returns ErrDepthLimit. Subprocess tests cover self/mutual yield, public YieldBlock and recursive include/exec/includeIfExists.
- Deterministic native-only silent-loop cancellation, callback entry/release/exit ownership, empty/deadline/custom-cause cases, cyclic equality/pointer traversal, numeric scan preflight, exact/large limit boundaries and concurrent shared-template budgets pass.
- Exact step and depth failures escape nested try, depth failure escapes isset, and content work consumes the same fuel. Writer/pool/rollback compatibility and escaper callback reentry pass.
- Go 1.27.3/darwin/arm64 full normal and separate race suites: `go test [-race] -count=1 -p=1 -parallel=2 -timeout=120s ./...` pass. Additional recovery coverage passes a focused race run. `go vet ./...` passes.
- Go 1.16.15 full suite passes with `-ldflags=-linkmode=external`; modern macOS rejects two internally linked test binaries for missing LC_UUID. The linker issue and warnings were retained separately from source/test results.

Diagnostic cached-execute benchmarks use three 300 ms samples, GOMAXPROCS=2, positive limits 1,000,000/128 and context.Background; CPU/alloc/heap/mutex/block profiles were captured separately and inspected. Median ns/op (upstream / fork Execute / ExecuteContext): header 76/115/123; 8 KiB body 6370/6286/6272; silent 100-advance loop 1351/1145/1345; block composition 2698/3129/3130. Allocation counts match upstream on all four fixtures after consolidating checked adapters. Profiles show remaining checkpoint dispatch cost; the header regresses 62% (47 ns) while the four-fixture median ratio is about 1.08. This diagnostic result does not establish p99, concurrent, compile or application performance.
title: Add synchronous context execution with step and depth limits
